product_one_liner.value: Authenticate is an identity-verification and background-check platform with developer APIs and SDKs for businesses, including fintech, logistics, and government organizations, that confirms users' identities and checks criminal, driving, employment, and education records.
product_one_liner.notes: Authenticate's homepage, https://authenticate.com/, describes identity verification and checks of criminal, driving, employment, and education records. Its product page, https://authenticate.com/products/document-verification, names customer sectors, while the homepage describes its APIs and SDKs.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page at https://info.authenticate.com/pricing-info describes a pay-as-you-go pricing model and states a $100 minimum deposit, so pricing_page is true.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Authenticate's customer testimonials in its launch article at https://authenticate.com/resources/blog/Identity-Verification-Infrastructure-as-a-Service name RunnerCity and NotaryHub.com and describe their use of Authenticate. | named_customers.0: Authenticate's customer testimonial at https://authenticate.com/resources/blog/Identity-Verification-Infrastructure-as-a-Service identifies RunnerCity as using the service. | named_customers.1: The same customer-testimonial page names NotaryHub.com and describes its use of Authenticate.

founded_year.notes: The company profile at https://prospeo.io/c/authenticate lists its founding year as 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog index at https://authenticate.com/resources/blog shows business-facing identity-verification and background-check content. The reviewed index does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built, so it does not meet the stated threshold for an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public developer hub at https://docs.authenticate.com/ has comprehensive guides, API reference material, and multiple articles, including Create a User and Get Medallion JWT.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers page at https://apply.workable.com/authenticate?lng=en says there are no job openings, so no AI, ML, or data-science role is currently open.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public documentation at https://docs.authenticate.com/, security FAQ at https://info.authenticate.com/security, blog index at https://authenticate.com/resources/blog, and privacy policy at https://authenticate.com/privacy-policy do not identify an AI model or AI provider. The privacy policy names Salesforce, HubSpot, and LinkedIn as data providers, not as AI model providers; the FAQ identifies AWS as a cloud-backup partner.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Authenticate's security and compliance page, https://authenticate.com/resources/security-and-compliance, names SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS. launched_6mo.notes: The newest explicit introduction located was ReAuthenticate, published 2 April 2024 at https://authenticate.com/resources/blog/free-kyc. The 30 June 2026 ReAuthenticate post at https://authenticate.com/resources/blog/easy-security-with-reauthenticate is an explainer, and the 1 October 2026 LinkedIn post is identity-verification guidance rather than a product launch. No qualifying launch was found in the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company people page at https://www.cbinsights.com/company/authenticate/people reports four executives but only exposes one named leader; the others are hidden behind subscription prompts. With an incomplete roster and no verifiable dated appointment or departure, the 12-month change is unknown rather than false.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page at https://info.authenticate.com/integrations?hsLang=en lists property-management-system integrations (including Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, Lodgify, OwnerRez, and SuiteOp), not CRM or sales/marketing systems. Salesforce and HubSpot are described in the privacy policy as business-data providers, not as the company's CRM stack.
